floater.name: xui_studio
floater.title: XUI Studio
floater.floater.string: No editor: set the ExternalEditor setting or the LL_XUI_EDITOR environment variable, with %s for the file and %L for the line.
Select a file.
This kind of file is catalogued and searched, not built.
[TAG] is a viewer widget: a shell build does not run its constructor. Catalogued and searched.
[VIEWS] views in [MS] ms, [DIAG] findings, [SKIN]/[LANG]
[VIEWS] views in [MS] ms, [DIAG] findings, [SKIN]/[LANG]; the registered floater, so no handles
Could not build [FILE]: see the findings.
Reloaded after a change on disk.
No matches.
Nothing is being previewed.
[FILE] in [SKIN]/[LANG]
[FILE] in [SKIN], [LANG] beside [LANG2]
, holding while [FILE] waits
The canvas is held on [FILE]; [PENDING] is built when the pin comes off.
The canvas is held on [FILE], which is the file the catalog is on.
Moves write to [FILE] in [LAYER]
Select an element to move it.
Nothing is selected.
Wrote [ATTRS] to [FILE] in [LAYER]
Lined [COUNT] up in [FILE] in [LAYER]
Select more than one element: shift-control-click on the canvas, or hold shift in the outline. The one the handles are on is the one the rest line up with.
Nothing to move: what is selected is already lined up, or a stack places it.
Took [ATTRS] out of [FILE] in [LAYER]; whatever was in force before it is in force again
Wrote [ATTRS] to [FILE] in [LAYER]; the preview's own frame is placed here, not by the file
Moved the preview on its canvas. Where it sits here is not in the file, so nothing was written.
The preview's own frame is placed here, not by the file: its size is editable, its position is not.
Put [FILE] back the way it was.
Did that to [FILE] again.
Wrote [FILE].
Wrote [FILE] and moved [MOVES] translations to where it now puts them.
No translation stops applying because of this.
[COUNT] translations stop applying if this is written as it stands: [LANGS]. Save and Repair Translations moves them.
Read [FILE] again; what was done to it is gone.
Nothing has been changed.
[FILE] has changes that are not written. Save or revert first.
[FILE] changed on disk, and there are changes here that are not written. Save to keep these, or revert to take those.
[TRANSLATED] translated, [MISSING] missing, [NOTAPPLIED] applying to nothing, [PLACEHOLDERS] stale, [FORBIDDEN] forbidden
Select a file and a language.
Wrote [FIELD] into [FILE]
Moved [MOVES] values into place in [FILE]
Moved [MOVES] values into place across [FILES] files in [LANG]
Nothing in [FILE] is written at a path the base has moved on from.
Choose a language other than the base to translate into.
Gave [FILES] files in [LANG] the base's root name; [LEFT] left alone as translations of something else
Counting what every language's overlay does...
Counted [DONE] of [TOTAL] files
[COVERED] values arrive, [NOTHING] apply to nothing; table written to [FILE]
Sent [NAME] through the channels; the Channels tab says where it went.
Answered [NAME] with [BUTTON].
no such parameter
[SUMMARY]; written to [FILE]
Could not write [FILE]
[WHAT] is cut; select where it goes and choose Move It Here.
Nothing is cut, or it is cut and this is where it already is.
Nothing beside it that way.
[WHAT] now lives in [INTO], with its position written for where it landed.
A layout stack lays its panels out itself: drag the edge along the stack to change the one dimension it reads.
Wrote [ATTRS] to [FILE] in [LAYER]; [SIBLING] gives up the room
[NAME] <[TAG]> [CLASS]
[NAME] built in code [CLASS]

menu_item_call.label: Open the File This Element Names
menu_item_call.name: open_nested

menu_item_check.label: Preview in a Window of its Own
menu_item_check.name: float_preview

button.label: Library
button.name: library_btn
button.tool_tip: Every tag a file may write, what the schema knows about each, and one of it built to look at (Control+Shift+L)

button.label: Edit
button.name: edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Open the selected element's file in the external editor at its line

button.label: Navigator
button.name: fold_navigator
button.tool_tip: The pane of files, the outline, search and the library, down the left (Control+0)

button.label: Tables
button.name: fold_bottom
button.tool_tip: The band under the canvas: findings, translation, notices and channels (Control+Shift+B)

button.label: Inspectors
button.name: fold_inspectors
button.tool_tip: The inspectors of the selected element, down the right (Control+Alt+0)

panel.name: files_mode
panel.tool_tip: Files: every XUI file in the skin, with the ones the chosen skin and language have of their own

scroll_list.columns.label: L
scroll_list.columns.name: lang
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: The chosen language has a file

scroll_list.columns.label: S
scroll_list.columns.name: skin
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: The chosen skin has a file

panel.name: outline_mode
panel.tool_tip: Outline: the tree of the previewed file, with its filter and the buttons that reorder it

layout_panel.name: edit_target_row

text.name: edit_target
text.tool_tip: Ctrl-click an element in the preview to select it and Ctrl-drag to move it; the middle handle moves it and the corners and edges resize it; arrows move it a pixel and ten with shift; a plain click works the widget itself

layout_panel.text: Select an element to move it.

button.label: Up
button.name: tree_up
button.tool_tip: Move the element before the one above it (Control+Up)

button.label: Down
button.name: tree_down
button.tool_tip: Move the element after the one below it (Control+Down)

button.label: In
button.name: tree_in
button.tool_tip: Make it a child of the element above it (Control+Right)

button.label: Out
button.name: tree_out
button.tool_tip: Make it a sibling of its parent (Control+Left)

panel.name: find_mode
panel.tool_tip: Find: a search across every file and every layer

line_editor.name: find_query
line_editor.tool_tip: Search every file and layer; Enter runs it

panel.name: palette_mode
panel.tool_tip: Library: the tags the selected element may contain

scroll_list.name: palette
scroll_list.tool_tip: The tags the selected element may contain, from the registry it names as its children

button.label: Insert
button.name: palette_insert
button.tool_tip: Put one of these under the selected element, with a name and where it goes and nothing else

button.label: Shown
button.name: canvas_shown
button.tool_tip: Hide the preview and give the room to what is being read about it; what is on the canvas stays built

button.label: Pin
button.name: canvas_pinned
button.tool_tip: Hold the canvas on this file while the catalog is read; the file chosen meanwhile is taken when the pin comes off

button.label: Show
button.name: show_btn
button.tool_tip: Build the selected file again

button.label: Hide
button.name: hide_btn
button.tool_tip: Take what is on the canvas off it

button.label: Reload
button.name: reload_btn
button.tool_tip: Read the catalog and the file again from disk

spinner.name: canvas_zoom
spinner.tool_tip: How much bigger than life the preview is drawn, as a percentage; the numbers in it stay the file's own. Control and the wheel over the canvas moves it by the same step.

button.label: Rulers
button.name: canvas_rulers
button.tool_tip: A rule along the top and the left of the canvas, numbered in the file's own coordinates

button.label: Snap
button.name: canvas_snap
button.tool_tip: A drag lands on the grid rather than where the pointer is

combo_box.name: canvas_grid
combo_box.tool_tip: How far apart the grid is, and how far a snapped drag moves

check_box.label: Second
check_box.name: secondary_check
check_box.tool_tip: Build the file a second time in another language, on the canvas beside the first, sharing its selection

button.label: L
button.name: align_left
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the left edge of the one the handles are on

button.label: C
button.name: align_centre
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the middle of the one the handles are on, across

button.label: R
button.name: align_right
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the right edge of the one the handles are on

button.label: T
button.name: align_top
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the top of the one the handles are on

button.label: M
button.name: align_middle
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the middle of the one the handles are on, down

button.label: B
button.name: align_bottom
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the bottom of the one the handles are on

panel.label: Findings
panel.name: findings_mode
panel.tool_tip: What the parser, the factory, the layer merge and the rules found in this file

scroll_list.name: findings
scroll_list.tool_tip: What the parser, the factory, the layer merge and the rules found; double-click selects the element

panel.label: Translation
panel.name: translation_mode
panel.tool_tip: One row per field a translator writes, for the chosen language

combo_box.name: translate_language
combo_box.tool_tip: The language this table is about, which the second variant on the canvas shows

button.label: Repair file
button.name: translate_repair_file
button.tool_tip: Move every value this file writes at a path the base has moved on from, and change nothing else

button.label: Repair language
button.name: translate_repair_all
button.tool_tip: The same over every file this language has

button.label: Repair roots
button.name: translate_repair_roots
button.tool_tip: Give back the base's root name to the files of this language that carry another, or none: the root is what a whole file is matched on

scroll_list.name: translate_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: One row per field a translator writes; double-click selects the element

scroll_list.columns.label: Fits
scroll_list.columns.name: fits
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: Whether the translation fits its widget in the second variant

line_editor.label: Select a row above to translate it
line_editor.name: translate_value
line_editor.tool_tip: The translation for the selected row; Return writes it into the language's file

button.label: Write
button.name: translate_write
button.tool_tip: Write it where the merge will find it, under the ancestors the base gives it

panel.label: Notices
panel.name: notifications_mode
panel.tool_tip: Every template notifications.xml declares, and the panel each would produce

scroll_list.name: notifications
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every template notifications.xml declares; select one to build the panel it would produce

button.label: Post
button.name: notification_post
button.tool_tip: Send the selected notification for real, through the channels, as the viewer would

panel.label: Channels
panel.name: channels_mode
panel.tool_tip: What the notification system did with what was posted

combo_box.name: channel_response
combo_box.tool_tip: The buttons the selected notification's form declares

button.label: Respond
button.name: channel_respond
button.tool_tip: Answer the notification as a user would, which is a real answer

button.label: Clear
button.name: channel_clear
button.tool_tip: Empty the list; what has already been through the channels stays through them

scroll_list.name: channels
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every notification through every channel since this floater opened, in the order the channels process them

check_box.label: Only what the files write
check_box.name: attributes_authored
check_box.tool_tip: The short list an author is working in: the fields this file actually writes

check_box.label: Nested fields
check_box.name: attributes_nested
check_box.tool_tip: The leaves of the blocks a field carries, such as font.name and bg_alpha_color.alpha. A nested field the file writes is always shown.

scroll_list.name: selection_findings
scroll_list.tool_tip: The findings on the selected element and everything below it
